attrs.evidence: governance/blind_run.mjs v0.2.0 (TRVM-BLIND-IMPLEMENTATION-RUN-v2) + receipts/. run_id binds every subject's package_digest and the status, so aborting produces a DIFFERENT record rather than an edit of the live one. Each adapter's package digest is verified BEFORE it is executed -- for JavaScript the package is the implementation the adapter reaches, not merely the adapter file, because an adapter is a thin shell over a checker and freezing only the shell freezes nothing. The P4.6 run was ABORTED under this law with a receipt recording why. Gate `gov-spec` and `gov-nest`.
attrs.statement: A STATUS WORD THAT NAMES AN IMPLEMENTATION WITHOUT DIGESTING IT FREEZES NOTHING. P4.6's run record said `status: FROZEN` and carried no candidate source digest, no binary digest, no environment and no instrument digest, so FROZEN meant only that the run had SELECTED A RELEASE. An implementation could have been adjusted after seeing a hidden challenge and nothing in the record would have moved. A run is now a state machine -- PINNED (srel + bpkg + instrument + the reference subject) / CANDIDATE_FROZEN (+ the candidate's source digest, binary digest and recorded environment) / REVEALED / COMPLETE / ABORTED -- and THE REVEAL IS REFUSED BEFORE CANDIDATE_FROZEN, which is the one transition the record exists to guard: opening the challenge set first is how an implementation comes to be adjusted in the light of the thing it is about to be measured on. Every transition writes an IMMUTABLE RECEIPT rather than overwriting the only record of what the experiment was.
